subject: Decision Making
subcategory: The Science of Risk and Reward
title: Embracing Calculated Risk
description: A short lesson to help you apply Embracing Calculated Risk.

hook.text: Jeff Bezos left a lucrative Wall Street job to sell books online. He used a regret minimization framework to decide.

buildup.text: He imagined himself at 80 and asked: will I regret not trying? The answer was yes.

discovery.text: Calculated risk is not recklessness. It means understanding the odds, limiting the downside.

twist.text: The biggest risk is often taking no risk at all. Careers, businesses, and lives stagnate when fear prevents all action.

climax.text: Mastering risk means choosing which risks to take, not avoiding all risk. Risk is the price of every meaningful reward.

punchline.text: Embracing Calculated Risk: good judgment beats certainty every time.

quiz.question: What framework did Jeff Bezos use to decide to start Amazon?
options: Regret minimization — imagining what he'd regret at age 80
